name: 男の子（基本）ジェスチャー
prompt: Phase 5 ①c gesture sheet, composed by scripts/factory/compose_gesture_sheet.py from the bench-approved takes (2026-08-10, PR #96; owner picks: floor sit = the video-lane settled sit, sleep/wave = the reference+instruction nano takes, dance = the wan loop). Sources, all generated via Cloudflare AI Gateway (kaede-assets) from the committed stand frame on a 720px green canvas (character ~470px tall): sit = frame 120 of the wan-2.7-i2v sit-down clip (prompt: sits down on the ground and then stays perfectly still, bottom on the ground line, knees bent, hands on knees; motionless from ~frame 80); sleep = nano-banana-2 pose edit (lies asleep on his side ON the ground line, head right, eyes closed, one arm folded, knees slightly bent); wave = nano-banana-2 pose edit (near arm raised high, elbow bent, open palm waving, far arm relaxed); dance-a..h = frames 34/37/40/43/46/49/52/55 of the wan-2.7-i2v dance clip (prompt: cheerful perfectly-looping dance cycle, bounces to a steady beat stepping side to side, arms swinging overhead and down, hips swaying; adopted 24-frame cycle from frame 34, loop-closure IoU 0.932, 100ms per sampled frame = DANCE_FRAME_MS). Scale normalization back to the 720 canvas: nano stills x720/1024, wan frames x720/1440, verified per cell by hair-blob width against the stand (fail loud). Neck anchors are hair-blob estimates persisted as neckAnchors overrides — the structural neck detector breaks on arms-over-head dance frames and the lying sleeper (both measured in the ①c bench); the sleep anchor is approximate by design (nothing renders from it: the busy headgear overlay hides on sleep). NO head composite on the dance frames — erase-then-paste erases arms crossing above the neck line (measured); the video-native heads passed the calibrated per-frame palette-drift gate and videoReview (minor wobble, judged acceptable at game scale).
